# 0024 Phase 4: esbuild adapter and playground

Status: done
Priority: low
Owner: unassigned
Agent: claude-sonnet
Area: adapters
Depends on: 0009, 0010, 0011

## Context
REQUIREMENTS.md §12.4, §21 Phase 4: `@mithril-inspector/esbuild` using `build.onResolve` / `build.onLoad` / `build.onEnd`, supporting transformation and runtime injection, with an optional helper dev server for open-in-editor. Repo layout (§4) includes `apps/playground-esbuild`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- esbuild plugin transforms Mithril modules via the shared `transformMithrilModule` and injects the runtime; source maps preserved.
- Helper development server (reusing `@mithril-inspector/server`) provides the open-in-editor endpoint; overlay bootstrap injection documented for esbuild-served HTML.
- `apps/playground-esbuild` demonstrates picker → open-in-editor end-to-end.
- Production/minified builds exclude all inspector code by default.
- Unit tests for onResolve/onLoad wiring; integration fixture build.

## Implementation Notes
- esbuild has no HTML pipeline: document the manual `<script>` injection or serve-mode injection strategy.
- No HMR in plain esbuild serve — mapping-invalidation logic (0007) does not apply; note this as a documented limitation (§25.9).

## Agent Notes
- 2026-07-15: task created from REQUIREMENTS.md conversion; no work started.
- 2026-07-20 claude-sonnet: Implemented `@mithril-inspector/esbuild` via TDD, reusing `@mithril-inspector/adapter-kit`/`@mithril-inspector/server` exactly like the Rollup adapter (0023) rather than reimplementing anything (§12.1, ADR-004):
  - **`plugin.ts`**: `mithrilInspector(options?, env?): Plugin` — a single esbuild plugin built from all three hooks the Context names. `onResolve` (filtered to `virtual:mithril-inspector/...`) + `onLoad` (namespace `mithril-inspector-virtual`) serve the virtual runtime/overlay bootstrap modules — esbuild has no `\0`-prefix virtual-module convention of its own, so a plugin namespace is the idiomatic equivalent (§11.2 analog). A second `onLoad` (filtered to `.js`/`.jsx`/`.ts`/`.tsx`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`/`.mts`/`.cts`) reads each matched file itself (esbuild's `onLoad` has no ready-made source text the way Rollup/Vite's `transform` hook does) and calls the same `transformMithrilModule`, short-circuited by adapter-kit's `shouldAttemptTransform` before ever touching disk for `node_modules`/self-package paths. Source maps: esbuild's `OnLoadResult` has no dedicated map field, so the transform's MagicString map is appended as a `//# sourceMappingURL=data:application/json;...` comment (`map.toUrl()`), which esbuild's own source-map handling picks up and chains into the final output map — verified end to end via `tests/browser`-style manual inspection is out of scope here, but the integration fixture test asserts the map is present and esbuild accepts it without error.
  - **Dev-only/minified-build guard** (§12.4 AC: "production/minified builds exclude all inspector code by default"): active only when `resolved.enabled` (the same `NODE_ENV`-based default every adapter uses) **and** `build.initialOptions.minify !== true`, unless `includeInProduction`. esbuild has no `command === "build"` a plugin can read the way Vite does, so `minify` is used as the additional production signal — a plain `esbuild --minify` run excludes inspector code even without `NODE_ENV=production` set, which is a stronger guarantee than Rollup's watch-mode-only gate.
  - **Helper development server** (AC: "reusing `@mithril-inspector/server`"): new `dev-server.ts` — `createEsbuildDevServer(options)`, a small `node:http` server that mounts `createInspectorMiddleware` in front of a minimal static-file handler (`resolve()` + root-containment check, directory → `index.html`, small MIME map). Necessary because esbuild's own `context().serve()` has no middleware hook to attach the editor endpoint to, and the endpoint's no-CORS/loopback-only posture (§10.2) requires same-origin with whatever serves the app — this server solves both by serving both from one process. Exported standalone (for a companion-script pattern, mirroring Rollup's `startInspectorServer`) and wired as an opt-in plugin option (`devServer: { servedir, host?, port? }`) started lazily on the first `onEnd` (returns the startup `Promise` so esbuild — and the unit tests — await real readiness on that first call only) and stopped via `onDispose`. This is the concrete use of `onEnd`/`onDispose` the Context's three-hooks framing implies beyond onResolve/onLoad.
  - **Virtual module resolution requires an explicit `resolveDir`** (a real bug caught by manually running the playground, not by unit tests, since the integration/unit tests mark `@mithril-inspector/*` external and never actually resolve them): esbuild's `onLoad` does not infer a resolve directory for non-`file`-namespace results the way Rollup/Vite's virtual-module story does, so the generated runtime/overlay bootstrap code's own `import { createRuntime } from "@mithril-inspector/runtime"` failed to resolve in the playground (which does not mark those packages external) with `"didn't set a resolve directory"`. Fixed by setting `resolveDir` to `@mithril-inspector/esbuild`'s own package directory (via `import.meta.url`), which does declare `runtime`/`overlay`/etc. as direct dependencies.
  - **Overlay bootstrap injection** (Implementation Notes: "document the manual `<script>` injection or serve-mode injection strategy"): documented both in `packages/esbuild/README.md` — (1) a guarded `import("virtual:mithril-inspector/overlay")` in application code (what the playground uses, matching Rollup's precedent), or (2) a dedicated entry point built to its own output file plus a manual `<script>` tag, for projects that want zero application-code edits.
  - **`apps/playground-esbuild`**: a small Mithril app (`Greeting` object, `Counter` closure with a real `onclick` for verifying click-suppression, `ItemList` closure with a keyed list) built via `scripts/dev.mjs` (`esbuild.context().watch()` + the plugin's `devServer` option, `editor: "code"`) and `scripts/build.mjs` (one-off `esbuild.build()`, `minify: true`, plugin still wired up so its own guard — not the script's omission of the plugin — does the exclusion). An `__DEV__` global set via esbuild's `define` (`"true"`/`"false"`) guards the overlay import so esbuild's dead-code elimination removes the unresolvable `virtual:mithril-inspector/overlay` specifier from the production bundle entirely (verified: `grep` for inspector markers in `dist/main.js` after `pnpm build` finds zero matches). Manually verified end-to-end over real HTTP: `pnpm dev` starts the combined server, `GET /` and `GET /dist/main.js` serve correctly, `POST /__mithril-inspector/open-in-editor` correctly rejects malformed JSON (`INVALID_JSON`) and out-of-root files (`FILE_OUTSIDE_ROOT`) — a real successful editor launch was deliberately not exercised manually (VS Code is installed on this machine; that pipeline is already covered by `packages/server`'s own extensive launch tests) to avoid side effects.
  - **Shared package updates**: `packages/adapter-kit/src/module-filter.ts`'s `SELF_PACKAGE` regex extended to include `esbuild` (+ 1 test), matching the precedent set when `rollup` was added in 0023.
  - **Docs/release wiring**: `packages/esbuild/README.md` (usage, what onResolve/onLoad/onEnd each do, the minify-aware dev-only guard, the `devServer` option, both overlay-mounting patterns, options reference pointing at vite's); `apps/playground-esbuild/README.md`; root `README.md`'s "Other bundlers" section gained an esbuild paragraph, and the Releasing section's package count/list updated to nine including `esbuild`; `CLAUDE.md`'s bundler-independence bullet now names `esbuild` alongside `vite`/`rollup`. `scripts/release.mjs`'s `PACKAGES` list extended to `[..., "rollup", "esbuild"]`; `pnpm release:dry-run` confirms the version sync holds across all nine packages. `packages/esbuild` set to version `0.1.0` (was `0.0.0`/private, from the 0001 scaffold) to match.
  - Verified: 25 new tests in `packages/esbuild` (`plugin.test.ts` 15 — dev-only/minify gate, virtual module resolution, transform+sourcemap wiring, node_modules/self-package short-circuit, `devServer` onEnd/onDispose wiring over a real ephemeral-port server; `dev-server.test.ts` 6 — static serving, directory→index.html, 404, path-traversal rejection, editor-middleware mount, ephemeral port/close; `index.test.ts` 4), all via `pnpm --filter @mithril-inspector/esbuild test` = 25/25. 5 new tests in `tests/integration/src/esbuild-fixture-build.test.ts` (minified build excludes inspector code by default; a plain dev build actively resolves+inlines the virtual runtime through the real onResolve/onLoad pipeline; `includeInProduction` forces it into a minified build; `enabled:false` stays inactive regardless; a real `esbuild.context()/watch()` cycle activates it), via `vitest run src/esbuild-fixture-build.test.ts` = 5/5. 1 new test in `packages/adapter-kit/src/module-filter.test.ts`, via `vitest run` in that package = 6/6 (whole file). Full-workspace `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm -r test` (21 workspace projects) all clean/green, including the unaffected real-Chromium `tests/browser` suite (27 tests) and the full `packages/rollup`/`vite` suites (unaffected by the `adapter-kit` regex extension).
